title: task edit --if-revision reports validation, not conflict, when a stale edit carries a removal that no longer matches
description: Reported by opum-cli-e2e (TASK-90), 2026-09-25, against installed quest 0.10.0. Reproduced here on dev 85107ac: add label doc:S, read revision R1, a second writer removes doc:S, then `task edit --remove-label doc:S --if-revision R1` exits 6 validation ("no entry matches") instead of 5 conflict. The same happens with --remove-assignee; a non-removal edit with the same stale R1 correctly exits 5. The help text promises an exit-5 conflict whenever the record has moved, unconditionally. CAUSE: in the single-edit CLI path (src/cli/commands/task/index.ts, case "edit"), buildEditPatch folds the patch, where RemovalValueNotFoundError (QCLI-297) is thrown, BEFORE TaskService.editOn checks ifRevision (tasks.ts:1019). editBatch checks each item before folding, so it is not affected. CONSEQUENCE: lore-cli LCLI-522 retries only on error_type conflict, so two writers removing the same label concurrently surface as validation and the retry never fires.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A stale --if-revision on a task edit whose removal no longer matches exits 5 conflict, proven for --remove-label and --remove-assignee and for every text- or id-addressed removal flag QCLI-297 covers
A current --if-revision with a non-matching removal still exits 6 validation (the QCLI-297 miss is unchanged)
A test fails without the fix and passes with it

implementationNotes: FIX: in the single-edit CLI path (src/cli/commands/task/index.ts, case "edit"), a stale --if-revision now skips buildEditPatch and passes an empty patch to editOn, whose existing QCLI-277 precondition returns the conflict (exit 5). The fold, and with it the QCLI-297 removal miss, runs only when the precondition holds. editBatch already checked each item first and is unchanged. TESTS in test/cli-task-edit-if-revision.test.ts: (1) the reported race, run for --remove-label and --remove-assignee: after a second writer removes the value, the stale removal exits 5 conflict; (2) all 8 by-value removal flags from the QCLI-297 table: a stale revision exits 5, and a current revision exits 6 validation, so the miss is unchanged. CONTROL: with index.ts at origin/dev 85107ac, exactly those 2 cases go red and the 5 existing cases stay green, as predicted. bun run check exit 0, 623 pass. Scope note: the reporter guessed nine QCLI-297 flags. The QCLI-297 table enumerates 8 by-value flags (the ordinal --remove-ac family is separate, raises check_index_out_of_range, and goes through the same fold, so the same skip covers it).
finalSummary: task edit --if-revision now refuses a stale edit as exit-5 conflict before folding the patch, so a concurrent removal of the same value surfaces as the conflict it is rather than as a QCLI-297 validation miss. This is what lore-cli LCLI-522 retry needs. Reported by opum-cli-e2e TASK-90 and reproduced on dev 85107ac. Verified across all 8 by-value removal flags in both directions (stale gives 5, current gives 6), by a control that turns red exactly the 2 new cases, and by bun run check (623 pass).
